usageNotes: Use this to browse the directory tree inside a PBS backup snapshot before restoring individual files. The `filepath` parameter must be base64-encoded; pass `/` (literal slash, not encoded) to start at the root of the archive. Currently limited to Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) snapshots — other backup types are not supported.

examples.summary: List root-level entries inside a PBS VM backup snapshot

tips: Leaf entries (leaf: true) are files; non-leaf entries are directories — recurse into them with another call using the returned `filepath` value.
The `filepath` values in the response are already base64-encoded and can be passed directly as `filepath` in the next request without re-encoding.
mtime and size are optional and may be absent for directory entries.
This endpoint only works when the target node is online and can reach the PBS datastore; ensure the storage is mounted before calling.
